product.description: A service that allows users to earn cashback by making purchases through partner online stores accessed via the CheckRewards app.

product.name: CheckRewards ScanCity Mini App
product.description: A Telegram mini app combining real-world city exploration with in-app tasks and game mechanics to earn in-game currency and rewards.

identifier.value: Task Posting Functionality in CheckRewards Game

product.name: Task Posting Functionality in CheckRewards Game
product.description: A feature allowing users to post brand-related tasks within the CheckRewards Game app for rewards, subject to content guidelines and payment in Telegram Stars.

product.name: Referral Program
product.description: A program that rewards users with bonuses for inviting friends to register and use the CheckRewards app via invitation links.

product.name: Vaga Restaurant Loyalty Program
product.description: A loyalty program offering cashback rewards for purchases made at Vaga Restaurant, tracked via receipt uploads in the CheckRewards app.
